name: Xinyu Xinyiji Artificial Intelligence Computing Center Project
developer: Xinyu Xinyiji Cooperation Demonstration Zone Management Committee
notes: Jiangxi digital-economy project list shows the Xinyiji AI intelligent computing center in Xinyu, with AI/base computing hardware and intelligent computing software platforms, scheduled 2023-12 to 2025-12; secondary report states investment of RMB 187.5m and 100P XFP16 compute.

name: Ganxi Node Cloud Data Center
developer: Jiangxi Unicom with Xinyiji Cooperation Demonstration Zone partners
notes: China IDCQuan reported Jiangxi Unicom and partners would build and operate the Ganxi node cloud data center in the Xinyiji Cooperation Demonstration Zone in Xinyu, providing colocation, cloud computing, and big-data services.

name: Yichun Big Data Computing Power Center Construction Project
developer: Yichun municipal digital/data authorities (not fully specified in source)
notes: IDCE reported the Yichun Big Data Computing Power Center project was filed on 2024-11-01, with RMB 450m total investment and procurement of 3,491 GPU/ government-cloud servers plus 400 hyperconverged all-in-one servers.

name: Ganxi Cloud Data Center
developer: Yichun / Yiyang New Area data-center operator (not fully specified in source)
notes: Local-media article describes the Ganxi Cloud Data Center in Yichun/Yiyang New Area as upgraded from storage to computing/AI services, with more than 15 PFLOPS intelligent compute and over 11 PB storage as of 2025-10 reporting cited by the article.

name: Lanyun Baicheng Advanced Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Securities Times reported the center in Taobei Economic Development Zone entered operation in June 2026, phase 1 investment RMB 1bn, designed 5,000P; the article says hardware peak compute can reach 7,000P across 320 cabinets and more than 1,000 high-end GPU servers.

name: Yunzhen (Baicheng) 5000P Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Suzhou Yunzhen Intelligent Computing Information Co., Ltd.
notes: Jilin government article places the 5,000P project in Tongyu Economic Development Zone and says it used renovation plus new-build works and was expected to start operation in June 2025; DTDATA reported RMB 3.1201bn investment and about 276 25kW IT cabinets from tender information.

name: Zhenlai Jindayuan 4750P Intelligent Computing Project
developer: Zhenlai County Jindayuan Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Jilin government article places the 4,750P project in Zhenlai County Economic Development Zone, using city power plus renewable energy; it says phase 1 is 750P and was expected to start operation in May 2025.

name: Daan Jiuzhang Zhijin 1000P Computing Power Center Project
developer: Jiuzhang Zhijin / Daan project company (not fully specified in source)
notes: China Daily reported the Daan intelligent computing industrial park broke ground in Daan Economic Development Zone on 2024-12-12 and would build a green intelligent computing center with up to 1,000P; Jilin government later identified it as the Daan Jiuzhang Zhijin 1000P project expected to come online by year-end 2025.

name: Changchun AI Innovation Base Changchun Computing Power Center
developer: Changfa Group / Northeast Asia Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: CCTV local report says the center is in Jingyue High-tech Industrial Development Zone, with 5,280 sqm site, 3,358 sqm floor area, supercomputing 10P plus intelligent computing 300P; phase 1 started 2022-10-06 and came online in 2023-05, while phase 2 was in grid-connection test operation in 2024.

name: Changchun New Area Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Changchun New Area government / public platform
notes: Changchun New Area official source reported trial operation in 2025; earlier Jilin news described the project as A-class data-center standard, PUE <=1.25, with AI platform, intelligent computing, storage, operation and industrial innovation platforms, and up to 200P initial intelligent compute.

name: Liaoyuan Data Computing Power Center Project
developer: To be selected by investment attraction
notes: Jilin government investment project proposes locating the center in Xi'an District, Liaoyuan; scope includes GPU compute pool, deterministic-network machine room, data storage center and support spaces, with 2,700P total compute planned in three phases: 500P, 1,000P, and 1,200P; total investment RMB 801.82m.

name: Siping AI Computing Power Center Construction Project
developer: To be selected by market-based investment attraction
notes: Jilin government investment project recommends Tiexi District, Siping; planned 1,000P GPU compute across three phases (300P, 600P, 1,000P), with 15 mu site, 10,000 sqm gross floor area, and RMB 1bn total investment.

name: Songyuan Intelligent Computing Center Construction Project
developer: To be selected by investment attraction; Qian'an County project service center coordinating
notes: Jilin government investment project locates the green AI-native 3,000P intelligent computing center in Qian'an County, Songyuan, with 15,000 sqm site, 10,000 sqm building area, PUE target below 1.2, and RMB 1.00618bn total investment.

name: Songyuan Guoxin Intelligent Computing Data Center Project
developer: Songyuan Guoxin Intelligent Computing Big Data Service Co., Ltd.
notes: Jilin government investment project places the project in Hadashan Eco-agriculture Tourism Demonstration Zone, with two 24,000 sqm data-center buildings, 6,300 cabinets, 6,000P planned compute (3,600P Nvidia H100 sparse compute plus 2,400P domestic compute), and RMB 2.25893bn total investment. Capacity estimate uses source cabinet counts and ratings: 1,260 x 12kW plus 5,040 x 10kW = 65.52MW IT load.
